scope: CPU preprocessing parameter contrast only, no inference/NPU/HTTP result
input_form: Exact rendered_text, add_special_tokens=False; expected input_ids from fixture JSON
arrival_process: All requests for a batch created together on same event loop; inter-sample gap0.1s

fixed.cpu_dependency_view: Image package files reused; torch_npu and .pth hooks omitted as in L010-R006; no edits to package files

block_design: A/A pair from distinct identical actors, plus A/B pair; interweave pairs with frozen seeded order; persist all rows
metrics: value equality and per-request ID digest outside timing
instrumentation: Use actual tokenizer directly in timed path; no SpyTokenizer or loader-trace wrapper. Setup/import/template generation, hashing, output checks and teardown outside timing. Warm workers first.
decision_gate: Compare paired effect interval with A/A variation per case. Preserve all throttled samples; report wall effect inconclusive if asymmetrical throttling dominates. CPU-time differences do not prove wall/PD benefit. No p99 claim from this sample size.
remaining_serving_gates: Actual enable_dynamic_batch_tokenizer in assigned PD frontend
P/D and MTP preserved; NPU weights/context capacity verification
